evidence.period: 2026-08 benchmark: 45 v1 baseline runs, 45 v2 runs after the routing and oracle corrections, 18 timing-ablation runs. Testing defaults are set from the ablation: all three timings passed 6 of 6, so timing did not separate quality on these task types, but implement-then-harden cost 65 per cent more tokens and 50 per cent more wall clock than acceptance-first or alongside. Defaults therefore stay acceptance-first for gate-bearing work and alongside for ordinary features; harden-last is reserved for spikes, where deferring the oracle is the point.
